name: Ultra-wideband ranging
plain: Lets the app measure exact distance and direction to other UWB devices.
meaning: Centimeter accurate nearby tracking: finding keys, car access, handoff. Part of Nearby devices on Android.

android.note: Needs UWB hardware; Jetpack UWB library API.

ios.store_policy: App Review 5.1.1; U1 or U2 chip required
ios.note: Ranging accuracy about 10 cm; direction needs two devices.

limits.headline: Can measure exact distance and direction to nearby UWB devices while the app is open
limits.user_action: You tap Find my item or start a nearby handoff
can: Measure distance to another UWB device, to within about 10 cm on iPhone
Point you toward the device when both support direction
Support finding keys, car access and handoff
cannot: Work on phones without UWB hardware
Give a direction from one device alone; direction needs two devices
limits.differs: Android groups this under Nearby devices; iPhone asks a separate Nearby Interaction question.

story.what_it_is: A very precise radio that measures how far and in what direction another gadget is.

marketing.name: Nearby Interaction
marketing.pitch: Use ultra wideband to find the precise distance and direction of nearby devices.

marketing.name: UWB on Android
marketing.pitch: Use ultra wideband for precise ranging between devices.

story.for_you: An arrow on screen points to your lost keys and counts down the meters. A car unlocks when you walk up. You can feel it work close up, down to a few centimetres.
story.for_makers: UWB is far more exact than Bluetooth or GPS indoors. It powers item finders, keyless entry and fast file sharing. It also makes tracking a person or a thing in a room very exact.

use_cases.example: You find lost keys with an arrow that points the way.
A car unlocks when your phone is close and you are on the correct side.
A party game uses phone to phone distance to pass a virtual ball.
You point your phone at a friend's phone to send a file.
A speaker passes music to the phone as you step closer.
A warehouse app finds a tool in a bin within a few centimetres.
A door opens only when your phone is truly at the door, not just near a wall.

story.android_note: Android needs UWB hardware and uses the Jetpack UWB library.
story.ios_note: iPhone ranging is accurate to about 10 cm. Direction needs two devices.

technical_bounds: Only works between devices running the same session
Needs UWB chips on both ends
